lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Mg(AlGe)4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies Al and Ge centers as tetrahedral, each coordinated by two Al and two Ge neighbors, while Mg adopts an octahedral environment with four Ge and two Sr neighbors and Sr shows higher geometric coordination. The Al and Ge tetrahedra exhibit corner-sharing, and Al tetrahedra also share corners with Mg octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
